known.summary: sharedFilesAdvice and printAdvice in the shipped plan.mjs are only rewrapped, with no behavior change; the gate lints but does not format this file, so the reformatting is diff noise outside the plan's steps.

STORED_ISSUE_FIELDS makes the write mutation select assignees and writeIssueIfUnchanged fails on a malformed assignees shape, but no post-write check reads the stored assignees, so the field only adds a way for a write to fail.
REPOSITORY_LABELS changes from a joined string to an array that is joined at its only use in readSnapshot; the change has no reason and widens the diff.
